result.summary: Ran the bounded repeat series the diagnosis said was required, through the real deployed path (ExecutionAdapterRegistry -> GeminiImageExecutionAdapter -> generateContent), and settled the image request protocol truthfully. A 9-call budget was stated in the evidence artifact before the first call and was exactly honoured (6 identical IMAGE-only single-shot repeats of the exact failing request, 2 with responseModalities ['TEXT','IMAGE'], 1 with ['TEXT','IMAGE'] plus generationConfig.imageConfig); 9 attempted, 9 recorded, no abort, and no metadata call was made, so generations == the stated total. The no-image response RECURRED: 2 of 9 executed calls (measured rate 0.2222) - 2/6 on the IMAGE-only shape, 0/2 on TEXT+IMAGE, 0/1 on TEXT+IMAGE+imageConfig. Both recurrences carried a provider-supplied finishReason=IMAGE_RECITATION with an empty response part list, no candidate and 0 candidate tokens, i.e. a provider content-side stop rather than an adapter, transport or modality-list failure; the same IMAGE-only shape returned decodable 1024x1024 JPEGs on 4 of its 6 calls. The worker is NOT described as stable, unreliable or broken beyond what the series supports. Request protocol: the production shape (responseModalities ['IMAGE'], no imageConfig) is accepted by this model and was made contract-declarable (optional response_modalities / image_config, production default unchanged, shape echoed into the result, the sanitized metadata and the persisted dispatch attempt); the provider also accepts ['TEXT','IMAGE']. Output size: a size stated only in the prompt is IGNORED (objective asked 64x64, every IMAGE-only call returned 1024x1024), while the provider's own parameter generationConfig.imageConfig={imageSize:'512'} was accepted and returned 512x512 - so size is controllable through that supported parameter and exact 64x64 is recorded as a known limitation, never as a pass. No readiness or verification criterion was weakened (the image node's deterministic contract is still 'an image part arrived and decodes'). Re-running scripts/e3_qualification_from_evidence.py moved google-nano-banana-2/vision off EVALUATING to QUALIFIED on the unchanged bar (11 recorded executions, 8 verified passes, 8 first-pass, all six checks pass, qualified_rows_without_evidence 0) - recorded as dispatch repeatability under the declared contract, explicitly not as 'always returns an image'. E2 integration stayed public-interface only: all 9 telemetry rows were written through governor.record_request() and read back from governor.db (all_found true), with the two failures recording status=error and output_tokens=null rather than an approximation; no SQL write was made to exec_brain.db or governor.db. E3 Stage 2 and production dispatch were NOT enabled. One driver defect was found and fixed inside the task: the first revision of the runner wrote evidence.json and then crashed in its markdown renderer; the provider cost was already spent at that point, so the artifacts were re-derived from the captured responses through a new --from-evidence path with 0 additional provider calls instead of re-running the series.
result.owner_action_required: Configure the seven remaining owner-local provider credentials so the Stage-2 readiness gate (scripts/e3_stage2_readiness_gate.py) can be re-run; nothing in this task is blocked on it.
